titre: Control Test n°3 — English (5th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

On Sunday, I go to the market with my mother. The market is big. There are many shops. We buy fruit and vegetables. My mother buys apples, bananas and tomatoes. I like bananas very much. We also buy bread and milk. The apples are red and the bananas are yellow. My mother pays the money. Then we go back home with a full basket.

Questions:
1) When does she go to the market? (1 pt)
2) Who does she go with? (1 pt)
3) What fruit does the mother buy? (1 pts)
4) What colour are the apples? (0.5 pt)
5) True or False: They go home with an empty basket. (0.5 pt)

Food - Classify
Write fruit or vegetable:
a) apple ← ...
b) tomato ← ...
c) banana ← ...
d) carrot ← ...

Complete
Complete with: ( market - buy - money - basket )
a) I go to the ....... .
b) I ....... fruit and vegetables.
c) I pay the ....... .
d) I put the food in a ....... .

Grammar - a / an / some
Complete with a, an or some:
a) I buy ....... apple.
b) I buy ....... bread.
c) I buy ....... banana.

Writing
Write 3 sentences about your visit to the market (what you buy).

My town.
Match the place with what you do there. Write the letter.
1) school
2) hospital
3) park
a) play
b) learn
c) see a doctor
